FEAT-4-STORY-36.title: Implement Core NPI Registry Lookup and Parsing Logic
FEAT-4-STORY-36.description: Build core logic in provider_detail_service to call CMS NPI Registry API, handle responses, and normalize provider demographics, taxonomy, and address data into the defined schema.

FEAT-4-STORY-37.title: Construct External Links (State Boards and Research Profiles)
FEAT-4-STORY-37.description: Extend provider_detail_service to generate state medical board URLs (DE, MS, VA) and research-related links based on provider attributes, ensuring consistent formatting and availability.

FEAT-4-STORY-38.title: Add Error Handling and Fallbacks for NPI Lookup Failures
FEAT-4-STORY-38.description: Implement robust error handling for API timeouts, empty responses, and malformed data, returning safe structured responses and logging via debug_logger without breaking downstream flows.
